summary_1line: A king seeking his lost son questions an ascetic about hope, learns its fragility, and witnesses the sage reveal himself as the god of righteousness.

image_candidates.scene_text: The emaciated sage Tanu stands before the anxious king in the forest hermitage, surrounded by silent ascetics as he speaks about the thinness of hope.
The sage miraculously brings the lost young prince before his father, the royal family bowing with heads touching the ascetic’s feet.
After rebuking the king, the ascetic reveals a radiant divine form as the god of righteousness before disappearing into the forest.
